title: Form 15G / Form 15H Self-Declaration Schema (Section 197A / Section 194A)
description: Statutory self-declaration by resident payee claiming receipt of interest income without deduction of tax

declarantName.description: Full legal name of the individual / senior citizen declarant

declarantPan.description: Permanent Account Number of the declarant

declarationFormType.description: Form 15G (Resident Individual below 60 years / HUF) or Form 15H (Senior Citizen aged 60 years or above)

financialYear.description: Financial year for which declaration is made

estimatedTotalIncome.description: Estimated total income of the declarant for the FY (For 15G, must not exceed basic exemption limit)

estimatedInterestIncome.description: Estimated interest income to which this declaration relates

uniqueIdentificationNumber.description: UIN allotted by the deductor upon upload to ITD portal

verificationConfirmed.description: Statutory attestation that the statements are true and correct
